about: [O1 critic] the clock tower, 'the landmark seen from everywhere': from the grand start, turn toward it (0, -90) with the eye level.

steps.look: [(() => { const p = G.controller.pos, dx = 0 - p.x, dz = -90 - p.z; const want = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz); let d = want - G.controller.yaw; d = Math.atan2(Math.sin(d), Math.cos(d)); return Math.round(-d / 0.0021); })(), Math.round((G.controller.pitch - 0.08) / 0.0021)]
